Overwatch - Breakout: Doctrine Hero Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/overwatch/

If Doomfist plans to make a new gauntlet, he’s going to need help from a very old friend. 

Join him and his allies as they work to break out Doctrine from the depths of Watchpoint: Grimsvotn in our newest Hero Trailer, ‘Breakout.’ 

And after, play as our newest Support Hero, Doctrine, during his limited time Hero Trial Sep 12-14 before his official release with the launch of Season 5.
